description: Consulta del histórico de rayos detectados is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Xunta de Galicia. Este JSON permite coñecer as posicións dos raios detectados, así como a súa condición de positivos ou negativos. Devolve, ademais, o número de raios detectados en Galicia, así como o número total de raios. Coverage: Xunta de Galicia. The portal shows the English title as "Consulta do histórico de raios detectados" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Xunta de Galicia. The listing shows 1 download or service links in JSON. The listing shows 2026-09-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/deed.gl). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
